name: VA-03
label: Safe D

key_factors: Strong Democratic district with +18 partisan lean
Long-serving incumbent Bobby Scott running for re-election
Republican challenger Edwin Rivera raised only about $6,600
Prediction markets price Democratic win around 95%
model.rationale: Bobby Scott holds a district with an 18-point Democratic lean and a large incumbency and fundraising edge, while his challenger has raised almost nothing. Markets price this as a near-certain Democratic hold, consistent with the fundamentals.
model.watch: Any late outside spending or a major incumbent scandal could narrow the margin, though a Republican upset remains highly unlikely.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Virginia's 3rd District is a heavily Democratic seat in the Hampton Roads area, with an 18-point Democratic partisan lean. Bobby Scott, the longtime incumbent, is running for re-election and holds a decisive financial advantage, having raised nearly $700,000 to challenger Edwin Rivera's roughly $6,600. Two independent candidates are on the ballot but show no meaningful resources or outside support.

No public polls or expert ratings cover this race, so the forecast rests on district fundamentals, the incumbent's advantages, and prediction markets, which price a Democratic win at about 95%. Everything points to a comfortable Scott re-election, with the only real question being the size of the margin rather than the winner.
